verdict.rationale: Convex runs developer-written TypeScript query, mutation, and action functions on its backend. The CLI pushes new function versions to the deployment automatically, and public functions are exposed at HTTP endpoints that return the result as a value. Client SDK usage is implied by first-party framework support (React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, etc.), and the hosted cloud service means no servers to set up. Missing for 10: an explicit production deploy workflow (evidence only shows pushes to the dev deployment), explicit documentation of SDK client invocation, an explicit serverless or no-server-management statement for functions, and independent hands-on corroboration of deployment.
